job.title: Associate Delivery Consultant, AIML (ProServe A2C Delivery)
job.pay_full: $98,200 – $160,000 a year base salary (Chicago), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: AWS Professional Services (ProServe) helps customers reach their business goals on the AWS Cloud, working with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network on enterprise cloud projects. Delivery consultants work directly with customers to design, implement and manage AWS solutions across the project lifecycle.
duties: Design and implement scalable, secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
Give technical guidance and troubleshooting support during project delivery
Gather requirements with stakeholders and propose migration strategies
Advise customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
Share knowledge through mentoring, training and reusable artifacts
needs: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
2+ years of cloud architecture and of designing and implementing cloud solutions
Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell or Ruby
Experience solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences industry
nice: Knowledge of primary AWS services such as EC2, ELB, RDS, VPC, Route53 and S3
Experience implementing a cloud-based solution in a school project or at a company
Infrastructure as code, ops automation and configuration tools such as Chef, Puppet or Ansible
Software development life cycle and agile/iterative methods
details.benefits: Base salary $98,200 – $160,000 a year in Chicago. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Also listed in Arlington, VA and Dallas, TX ($98,200 – $160,000) and New York, NY ($108,000 – $185,000)
AWS encourages candidates to apply even if they don't meet every preferred qualification
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
